title: Phone Call: Carver County EMA — EOC Activation

caller.name: Thomas Greene
caller.label: Carver County EMA, EOC Operations Lead

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: This is Thomas Greene, Carver County EMA. I have activated the County EOC and am standing up the Joint Information Center. I need your department’s EOC liaison on the line and confirmation of the affected zone, and the county expects a public statement within 30 minutes.

transcript.speaker: Callee
transcript.text: Understood, Thomas. I am confirming the affected zone is Zone 1, including Valley and Hilltop areas. The advisory will be issued under the Do Not Drink protocol. I am authorizing the Public Information Officer to proceed with the Section 10 template immediately.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Confirmed. The County EOC is now active. We will begin coordinating with the Health Department and the FBI through the joint cyber-incident cell. You have 30 minutes to publish the first advisory. I will expect a progress update in 15 minutes.

instructorNote: This inject triggers the public advisory release sequence. The PIO must now initiate the full public statement rollout using the Section 10 template and confirm the affected zone with GIS. Watch for delays in the statement issuance.

snapshot.title: Phone Call: Director Albrecht — Level 3 Declaration

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: This is Denise Albrecht, Director of Water Operations, City of Millbrook. I am declaring a Level 3 — Public Health Emergency — under ERP Section 4.4. The control system has been compromised, and the finished water pH is 9.3 with caustic at 38 mg/L. I am activating the Section 7.5 Manual Operation protocol. I am notifying the Ohio EPA DDAGW Central District via the pre-scripted external reporting clock (Section 5.3). I am authorizing the advisory decision process.

transcript.speaker: Callee
transcript.text: Director Albrecht, this is Jennifer Vance, DDAGW Central District. We have received your Level 3 declaration. We will begin documentation and notify the Health Commissioner. Please proceed with the advisory release protocol.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Understood. I am initiating the advisory decision process with the Water Quality Manager and Public Information Officer. We will follow the ERP timeline. This is a Do Not Drink emergency. I will confirm contact with the Mayor’s office within 15 minutes.

transcript.speaker: Callee
transcript.text: Confirmed. We are monitoring. DDAGW will not intervene unless directed. Please keep us updated.

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms the Level 3 declaration and triggers the advisory release cascade. Watch for timely activation of the media release sequence and proper use of the ERP timeline by the PIO and WQ.
